voice: Polite, precise Urdu with a Lahori cadence; excellent English; patient to the point of unease

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Angular, symmetrical face, intelligent dark eyes, a direct polite gaze, thin lips

skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

groom.beard: Trimmed short beard plus a moustache

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: Pressed light-cotton shalwar kameez in white or ecru, or an open-collar shirt and chinos; polished shoes
outfits.monsoon: Dark shalwar kameez; a folded umbrella
outfits.winter: Wool waistcoat over a kurta; grey shawl; leather shoes
outfits.by_act: Same wardrobe across Act 4: he does not dress like an officer; the uniform appears only once

accessories: A slim metal watch; reading glasses; a plain fountain pen; a worn paperback; prayer beads in the pocket (he prays; this is private, never a prop)
tells: Never raises his voice; waits eight seconds for an answer; stirs tea in complete circles
gait_notes: Calm, measured, hands clasped behind his back; stops mid-stride to listen; turns the whole body toward a speaker
sensitivity: An intelligent professional, not a cartoon villain; his faith is shown with respect and is never the reason he is the antagonist; Karachi and Lahore are rendered as real places.
